pylons_vi: 1 tháp nghiêng 12°, cao 145 m; dây văng neo sau màu đỏ

model3d.notes: Single 145 m pylon leaning 12° (press). The 230 m cable-stayed span is from the press; the back span (120 m) is estimated. Single central cable plane read from photos.

pylon_custom.description: Single straight concrete mast on the deck centreline, leaning ≈12° back (away from the 230 m span) like a sail. One central plane of white stays fans from the upper mast to the main span; a denser fan of RED back-stays runs from the same zone down to the back span. Mast lit purple/magenta at night.

colour: white mast; white main-span stays, red back-stays; purple night lighting
